name: Mitama no Yuki
source:
Main character's sister is invited to participate in a shrine maiden festival by an anonymous letter. As siblings arrive to the spot, mysterious events start to unfold around his sister. Village girl dies, and ancient powers come into action.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-march-2005-parfait-chocolat.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公的妹妹收到一封匿名信，受邀参加巫女祭典。兄妹二人抵达当地后，妹妹身边开始发生神秘事件。一名村中少女死亡，古老的力量也随之开始运作。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-march-2005-parfait-chocolat.html]vndbreview[/url]]
